[[Saltspray Beach (Kurzick)|Saltspray Beach]] is one of five outposts used for entering [[Alliance battle]]s from the [[Kurzick]] side.

==Getting there==
Speak to a [[Kurzick Kommandant]] at a Kurzick [[guild hall]] when the [[Kurzick-Luxon border]] is in between Kurzick and [[Luxon]] territory.
